articles.title: examining the macOS gcc binary
articles.summary: The macOS gcc binary is not just a simple alias for clang, but rather a binary that actually invokes the clang compiler. This binary, which is part of the libxcselect.dylib library, is used to select the compiler to use based on the tool name, and it does so by checking the tool name and invoking the corresponding compiler function. This binary is particularly interesting because it provides a way to dynamically select the compiler based on the tool name, which can be useful in certain development scenarios.
